title: Sr Advanced Data Scientist
description_text:
Job Description

The Sr Advanced Data Scientist – AI & Advanced Analytics is responsible for designing, building, and deploying Honeywell Aerospace–specific AI solutions that drive measurable improvements in productivity, speed, and business outcomes across enterprise functions and business verticals.

This role operates at the intersection of advanced analytics, classical machine learning, and Generative AI (LLMs and agentic systems). The individual will work closely with business stakeholders, IT, and engineering teams to translate complex business problems into scalable AI-driven solutions, owning the full lifecycle from ideation to production deployment and support.

Responsibilities

Key ResponsibilitiesUse Case Identification & Business Partnership
• Partner with business leaders and domain experts to identify, shape, and solidify high-value AI and analytics use cases
• Translate business problems into analytical, statistical, and AI-driven solution approaches
• Define clear success criteria, KPIs, and measurable business outcomes for each initiative

Data Understanding & Analytical Modeling
• Lead data discovery, data assessment, and data readiness activities across structured and unstructured data sources
• Perform complex data analysis, statistical modeling, and mathematical formulation to support solution design
• Select and apply appropriate classical ML techniques, advanced analytics, and AI models based on problem context

AI / ML Solution Development
• Design and develop end-to-end AI solutions using:
• Classical ML models
• Advanced analytics techniques
• Generative AI, LLMs, and agentic AI frameworks
• Build AI applications that integrate classical models and LLM-based components to solve real business problems
• Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, explainable, and enterprise-ready
MLOps & Production Deployment
• Drive MLOps practices, including model versioning, monitoring, retraining, and lifecycle management
• Partner with platform, cloud, and engineering teams to ensure robust production deployments
• Ensure reliability, performance, and compliance of AI solutions in enterprise environments

Technology Evaluation & Architecture Decisions
• Evaluate and recommend AI platforms, tools, and frameworks aligned with enterprise standards
• Make informed technology and architecture decisions across cloud and AI ecosystems
• Maintain strong understanding of AI platform capabilities, limitations, and trade-offs

Enterprise Integration & Adoption
• Design and deliver integrated AI solutions that work seamlessly with enterprise systems and workflows
• Drive ideation workshops and innovation events to help business teams understand and adopt AI solutions
• Support change management and adoption by ensuring solutions deliver clear, tangible business value

End-to-End Technical Ownership
• Own solution design, development, implementation, deployment, and ongoing support
• Act as the technical authority for assigned AI initiatives
• Mentor junior data scientists and contribute to building a strong AI engineering culture

Qualifications

Experience & Capabilities
• 8–10 years of experience in data science, advanced analytics, or applied AI roles
• Strong experience analyzing complex datasets and defining mathematical and statistical models
• Hands-on experience with:
• Classical machine learning models
• Advanced analytics techniques
• Generative AI, LLMs, and agentic AI systems
• At least 2 years of experience designing, developing, and implementing enterprise AI solutions across business functions or industry verticals
• Proven experience working across the full AI solution lifecycle, from ideation to production
Technology & Platform Experience
• Strong experience with cloud platforms, including:
• Microsoft Azure
• AWS
• Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
• Hands-on knowledge of AI platforms such as:
• Azure OpenAI
• Azure AI / Foundry
• Google Vertex AI
• AWS Bedrock
• Strong analytics, data engineering awareness, and domain understanding to support business-driven AI solutions
Education
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field

Who Will Succeed in This Role
• Techno-functional experts with hands-on AI / ML implementation experience
• Individuals who can define, build, deploy, and scale end-to-end AI solutions
• Professionals who can bridge business problems and advanced analytics / AI techniques
• Leaders who consistently deliver tangible, measurable outcomes using analytics, advanced analytics, and AI

fintech domain, ML Platforms, Spark, TensorFlow, Theano., Java, Python, R, Tableau

An AI-driven platform that streamlines cash-flow analysis and loan decisioning is Looking for:

Role

Company is seeking a Data Scientist to be a key member of the technical team, responsible for designing and developing algorithms to be integrated into their products. Experience in implementing various types of machine learning models, including neural networks, linear regression, polynomial networks, and factorization machines, among others, is required. This position requires experience in developing algorithms that have been integrated into commercial products.

Responsibilities
• Responsible for the creation, identification, development, and continuous evolution of the comapny''s machine learning based algorithms
• Communicate roadblocks, issues, and limitations related to algorithm development and make recommendations on creative solutions to build the product platform.

• Apply advanced statistical techniques such as principal component analysis (PCA), hypothesis testing, outlier detection, and feature selection methods (e.g., mutual information) to clean, transform, and curate datasets for optimal performance in machine learning models.
• Work closely with the Engineering team to understand the optimal timing of integrating and validating developed algorithms in our products throughout the entire software development lifecycle, from concept to product.
• Work closely with the Principal Data Scientist as part of a cross-functional team to develop and evolve the Vitalxchange technology stack and intellectual property.
• Helping to identify areas where risk management practices should be adopted
• Adhering to company policies and standards of conduct, and reporting incidents and observed anomalies or weaknesses

Requirements
• Minimum 3 years of experience in developing machine learning algorithms in an applied field (financial lending applications desirable)
• Expert-level knowledge of three or more of the following: Java, Python, R, Spark, Tensorflow, Theano.
• Experience with multiple ML platforms to process structured and unstructured data
• Familiar with multiple ML techniques such as Linear Regression, Logistic Regression, Decision Trees, Vector Machines, Supervised/Unsupervised Learning
• Familiar with statistical techniques for curating data and evaluating machine learning models, such as creating confidence intervals, t-tests, chi-square tests, Bayesian inference, linear regression, logistic regression, k-means, mutual information, etc.

Working hours

A 10-hour working week is standard in this role, but flexible working practices are common and you may need to work outside of a typical 9am to 5pm pattern.
As many freelancers work from home and remotely (from locations outside of the organization's workplace), you'll sometimes be able to choose your working hours.

Skills

• Ability to have an in-depth understanding of new processes and their operation.
• excellent spoken and written communication to explain your methods to a technical and non-technical audience

Career prospects are good at all levels for people with the right combination of skills, qualifications and experience.

title: Prompt Engineer Intern
description_text:
Job ID

PEI282508

Role

Prompt Engineer Intern

Location

Hyderabad

Experience

0 to 1 Year

Profile

We are hiring a world-class Prompt Engineer, someone with extreme clarity of thought, deep reasoning skills, and hands-on mastery of modern LLM behavior. It is for someone who understands prompting as a science: evaluation, ablation, latency tuning, hallucination control, guardrails and AGI-aligned orchestration.

Requirements
• Exceptional reasoning, logic structuring and analytical thinking.
• Ability to design deterministic, controlled, and testable prompts for production behaviour.
• Deep understanding of temperature, top-p, top-k, seed, max-tokens, repetition penalty, and their effects on model behaviour.
• Strong mastery of LLM guardrails, prompt-injection defense, role separation, Meta Logic, and system level prompt design.
• Solid understanding of modern LLMs and NLP systems (GPT, Claude, LLaMA, Qwen, Mistral, etc.).
• Knowledge of low-latency model families, quantization (GGUF, INT4/8), and inference trade-offs.
• Clear understanding of RAG, embeddings, vector DBs — including when not to use them.
• Ability to run evaluation pipelines (accuracy, F1, hallucination rate, consistency, JSON validity).
• Highly detail-oriented, structured thinker, fast learner.
• Strong communication, able to explain reasoning clearly and concisely.
• Comfortable building measurable experiments instead of intuition-based prompting.

Responsibilities
• Design high-accuracy prompts for reasoning, extraction, classification, and multi-step workflows.
• Build robust system + user prompt architectures with strict constraints and safety layers.
• Run temperature, seed, sampling, and ordering ablations to achieve deterministic and stable performance.
• Optimize prompts for latency, consistency, cost, and token efficiency.
• Reduce hallucinations using verification loops, guardrails, retrieval control, and role conditioning.
• Architect governing instructions for multi-agent systems and AGI-aligned assistants.
• Build hierarchical prompt layers (system meta-controller task-level tools).
• Select models based on latency, throughput, context window, and domain-specific performance.
• Collaborate with AI engineers on quantization, distillation, caching, and runtime optimizations.
• Maintain versioned prompt libraries with clear documentation, reproducibility, and experiment tracking.
• Work closely with ML, product, and engineering teams to deliver production-grade, scalable prompt flows.
• Write clear technical documents: architecture diagrams, ablation summaries, evaluation reports, and runbooks.

What You’ll Gain
• Deep exposure to real AGI workflows, multi-agent prompting, and large enterprise systems.
• Mastery in experimental prompting, evaluation science, and LLM orchestration.
• Opportunity to directly influence global flagship AI products across industries.
• Mentorship and collaboration with top engineers, AI researchers, and product innovators.

Join the awesome squad. Apply now!

title: Global Product Manager
description_text:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

Our Global Business Function & Service organizations are undergoing bold transformation to become truly tech-first, AI-powered organizations. We aim for structural reinvention and are reimagining how we operate, deliver value, and partner with the business by embedding technology, data, and AI at the core of every service and process.

In our journey to power end-to-end user experiences, our Digital organizations are moving away function-led service delivery to experience-led, platform-enabled capabilities that are scalable, intelligent, and continuously improving. This means:

· Creating seamless user journeys across functions, geographies, and tools

· Designing services as digital products, with clear ownership, roadmaps, and measurable outcomes

· Leveraging AI, automation, and advanced analytics to augment human expertise and unlock productivity

· Building interoperable, API-enabled platforms that reduce fragmentation and technical debt

· Shifting from reactive service provision to proactive, data-driven orchestration

As a Global Product Manager, you will be responsible for helping to define, build and implement Digital Product use cases and roadmap.

Among your responsibilities, you will:

· Determine business requirements to shape the product journey and user experience

· Serve as a Liaison between the business partners and the Product squad to ensure that key business objectives are met

· Working with key senior stakeholders to gather and document business requirements

· Defining the form, content, and capabilities provided for assigned products and solutions

· Identify key changes and impacts to our existing reporting capabilities and products

· Understanding multiple data sources and putting together practical and viable models for the analytics reports being prepared

· Developing comprehensive implementation plans along with delivering the output as defined in the project’s goals and objectives

· Assessing the gaps between the prioritized requirements and the Product capabilities, current and upcoming. Generating solution options and, with the use of an agreed set of design principles, selecting the preferred option to move forward

· Acting as a functional subject matter expert for partnering to troubleshoot data issues, redesign processes and develop reports

· Developing training materials and delivering trainings to end-users

· Curating backlog of requested enhancements

· Develop and track technical roadmap for feature enhancement

What You'll Bring

· Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Business, Product Management or Economics. Advanced degree preferred, but not required

· 6-8+ years of experience in Digital Products, analytics or equivalent field; less experience considered for exceptional performers, data visualization experience a plus

· End-to-end product management experience owning roadmap, discovery, delivery, and measurable outcomes for digital or technology-enabled products.

· Strong technical fluency, with experience in system integrations, APIs, cloud platforms, data analytics, and collaboration with engineering teams.

· Exceptional communication skills – both written and verbal – with the ability to tailor messaging across audiences and influence senior stakeholders

Who You'll Work With

· Product Owner and squad members to ensure a shared understanding of the work

· Cross-functional digital product team members

· BCG employees and managers as internal customers to inform and shape the journey

· Other Product Leaders within BCG, on solutions, workflows, product roadmap, and collaborate on best practices to ensure alignment between squads

· Agile Coaches for guidance on Agile ways of working and to promote agility within your team

· Chapter Leads and Tech Area Leaders for technical solutioning and delivery

Additional info

YOU’RE GOOD AT

· Demonstrating strong problem-solving and analytical skills: Structuring hypotheses, conducting rigorous analyses, and bringing clarity to ambiguous or undefined problems.

· Applying a detail-oriented and intellectually curious mindset: Working accurately through complex interdependencies, seeking root causes, and thriving in iterative, evolving environments.

· Building strong communication and collaboration practices: Developing trusted relationships across globally dispersed teams, functions, and time zones; adapting style to diverse audiences with tact and poise.

· Influencing stakeholders and driving impact: Persisting to drive change, leveraging networks effectively, and presenting insights clearly.

· Operating with strong organization and adaptability: Thriving in fast-paced, service-oriented environments with strong organizational and process management skills.

· Leading projects with results-driven execution: Managing multiple workstreams, prioritizing effectively, and delivering projects on schedule; familiarity with Agile methodologies is a plus

About Knowdis.ai

KnowDis AI is a research-driven startup building cutting-edge solutions in Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Generative AI. Our AI tools are designed to automate and enhance business processes, including content generation, information retrieval, and document understanding. We work with clients across industries such as e-commerce, fashion, banking, and pharma, helping them unlock value through enterprise-ready AI solutions.

Role overview

KnowDis.ai is building advanced AI-powered products focused on intelligent search, recommendations, and automation for enterprise and e-commerce applications. We are seeking a Product Manager — AI Products to drive product strategy, execution, and delivery for AI-driven search and recommendation systems.

This role is ideal for product managers with prior experience in large-scale e-commerce environments who understand how discovery, ranking, personalization, and recommendation engines impact user experience and business outcomes. The role requires close collaboration with engineering, AI/ML, design, and business teams to build scalable, data-driven products that deliver measurable performance improvements for customers.

You will work closely with founders and technical teams to translate complex AI capabilities into production-ready product features aligned with real-world commercial use cases.

Key responsibilities
• Product ownership & roadmap execution: Define and drive product roadmaps for AI-powered search and recommendation products, aligning business goals with technical capabilities and customer needs.
• E-commerce discovery optimization: Leverage prior experience in e-commerce ecosystems to improve product discovery, ranking, personalization, and recommendation workflows that enhance engagement and conversion outcomes.
• Requirement definition & execution: Translate business and customer requirements into detailed product specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria for engineering and AI teams.
• Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with AI/ML engineers, backend teams, designers, and business stakeholders to ensure timely delivery of scalable product features.
• Data-driven decision making: Define product metrics, analyze experimentation results, and drive continuous optimization through A/B testing and performance analysis.
• AI product translation: Bridge the gap between AI research and product implementation by converting technical capabilities into clear product use cases and customer value propositions.
• Customer & stakeholder engagement: Collaborate with enterprise clients and internal teams to gather feedback, understand use cases, and prioritize product enhancements.
• Product lifecycle management: Own feature delivery from ideation to launch, including prioritization, sprint planning, release coordination, and post-launch performance monitoring.
• Market and competitive analysis: Track industry trends in AI search, personalization, and commerce technology to inform product strategy and differentiation.
• Documentation & communication: Maintain clear product documentation, roadmap communication, and alignment across leadership, engineering, and go-to-market teams.

Required skills & experience
• 4–5 years of product management experience, preferably within e-commerce, marketplace, or consumer technology platforms.
• Direct experience working on product search, ranking systems, recommendation engines, or personalization features in large-scale e-commerce environments.
• Prior experience at leading e-commerce or marketplace companies (e.g., Flipkart, Meesho, or similar high-scale platforms) is strongly preferred.
• Strong understanding of user discovery journeys, catalog structures, search relevance, conversion optimization, and marketplace dynamics.
• Experience working closely with engineering and data science/ML teams in shipping data-driven products.
• Strong analytical mindset with experience defining product KPIs, running experiments, and interpreting performance metrics.
• Ability to understand AI/ML concepts at a functional level and translate technical discussions into product decisions.
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to work directly with founders and senior leadership.
• Experience working in agile product development environments with strong execution ownership.
• Comfort operating in a fast-paced startup environment with evolving priorities and high accountability.

Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline preferred.
• MBA or postgraduate degree in Product Management, Business, or Analytics is a plus but not mandatory.
• Demonstrated experience launching or scaling features impacting user discovery, engagement, or conversion metrics.

What success looks like (first 6–12 months)
• Clear product roadmap established for AI search and recommendation capabilities.
• Successful launch of product features improving discovery relevance and measurable customer outcomes.
• Strong collaboration established between product, AI engineering, and customer-facing teams.
• Data-driven experimentation framework implemented to continuously improve product performance.

Why join KnowDis.ai

This role offers the opportunity to shape next-generation AI products at the intersection of commerce and machine intelligence. You will work closely with founders and cutting-edge AI teams to build scalable systems that redefine how users discover products and information in real-world production environments.

About the Role:

We are looking for an experienced Product Manager to lead the development and scaling of our trading and investment platform. The role involves owning critical platform capabilities across brokerage systems including mutual funds, equities, and derivatives. You will work closely with engineering, risk, compliance, and operations teams to build scalable, reliable, and low-latency systems that power trading, portfolio management, and risk infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

1. Core Platform & System Ownership
• Define and evolve scalable platform capabilities including user lifecycle management such as onboarding, KYC, and risk profiling.
• Own account management systems, ledgers, portfolio holdings, P&L, and margin infrastructure.
• Manage the order lifecycle including order creation, modification, cancellation, and execution states.
• Build and improve notification systems, s, and real-time event-driven architecture.
• Ensure system reliability, scalability, and performance by collaborating with engineering on API contracts and modular service architecture.

2. Mutual Funds Product Systems
• Own transaction flows including Lumpsum investments, SIP, STP, SWP, and redemption processes.
• Define NAV processing, cut-off time logic, order batching, reconciliation, and RTA integrations.
• Improve portfolio computation accuracy, capital gains reporting, tax statements, and investor reporting systems.
• Ensure compliance with SEBI guidelines and audit requirements.

3. Equity Brokerage Systems
• Define and optimize Order Management Systems (OMS) and Risk Management Systems (RMS).
• Manage real-time market data ingestion, processing, and distribution systems.
• Oversee the full trade lifecycle: order placement → exchange routing → execution → clearing → settlement.
• Work on margin frameworks including VAR, ELM, and peak margin.
• Improve reconciliation processes, contract note generation, and settlement reporting.

4. Futures & Options (F&O) Systems
• Own derivatives lifecycle including option chain data structures and refresh mechanisms.
• Define margin calculation engines such as SPAN and exposure margin frameworks.
• Build risk analytics capabilities including Greeks computation and leverage monitoring.
• Implement safeguards for risk triggers, position limits, and margin checks.
• Ensure real-time MTM updates, P&L calculations, and expiry settlement handling.

5. Data, Risk & Controls
• Define and track key product KPIs including order success rate, latency, reconciliation accuracy, margin utilization, and trade volume.
• Drive event tracking architecture and instrumentation standards.
• Partner with Risk, Compliance, and Finance teams to ensure audit-grade traceability.
• Implement system guardrails to prevent misuse and regulatory breaches.

6. Execution & Stakeholder Alignment
• Translate business requirements into detailed PRDs with functional specifications, API contracts, state diagrams, and edge-case handling.
• Lead sprint planning, roadmap development, and backlog prioritization.
• Work closely with engineering, operations, compliance, risk teams, and exchange partners to deliver high-quality product releases.

Required Qualifications
• Product Management experience in fintech, brokerage, trading platforms, or capital markets.
• Strong understanding of market microstructure, exchange connectivity, clearing and settlement processes, and margin frameworks.
• Experience working with high-scale, low-latency transactional systems.
• Ability to define system workflows using sequence diagrams, state machines, and data models.
• Strong analytical skills with proficiency in SQL and product analytics tools.

Why join us?

A collaborative output driven program that brings cohesiveness across businesses through technology Improve the average revenue per use by increasing the cross-sell opportunities A solid 360 feedback from your peer teams on your support of their goals Respect, that is earned, not demanded from your peers and manager

Compensation:

If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 17 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

description_text:
About Pune Gas

Pune Gas is a leading provider of LPG and Natural Gas solutions for industrial and commercial applications, with a strong focus on innovation, safety, and customer-centric engineering. With 3 decades of experience, Pune Gas is evolving into a solutions-driven organization with integrated products, systems, and digital offerings.

Role Overview

We are looking for a hands-on product leader who will work closely with the Executive Director to drive product innovation, build new solutions (including SaaS platforms), and manage the lifecycle of existing offerings. This role combines product strategy, engineering coordination, business understanding, and execution ownership. The ideal candidate will act as a mini-CEO for all products, owning everything from ideation to commercialization and continuous improvement.

• Work closely with leadership to define and execute the product roadmap for Pune Gas
• Identify opportunities to build innovative solutions for LPG & Natural Gas users

• Conceptualize and develop new hardware + system + digital integrated solutions

2. Product Lifecycle Ownership
• Own end-to-end lifecycle of products:

Ideation → Design → Development → Testing → Launch → Improvement
• Continuously upgrade existing offerings such as: LPG systems, vaporizers, gas leak detection systems, etc.
• Ensure products remain competitive, scalable, and aligned with market needs

3. Tech & Engineering Coordination
• Work with internal teams and external vendors for software development, product design and prototyping
• Translate business requirements into technical specifications
• Drive execution timelines and ensure quality delivery

4. Commercial & Costing Ownership
• Develop product costing, pricing strategies, and unit economics
• Ensure products are commercially viable and aligned with business goals
• Support sales team in structuring customized solutions

5. Sales Enablement & Training
• Train the sales team on product features, value propositions and use cases
• Develop sales tools, pitch decks, and technical documentation

6. Marketing & Product Communication
• Collaborate with marketing to build brochures, catalogs, and product collaterals
• Clearly communicate product benefits and differentiation
• Support branding and positioning of new product lines

7. Team Leadership
• Lead and manage a team of 2–3 members
• Build a culture of innovation, ownership, and execution excellence
• Mentor team members and define clear roles and deliverables

Experience
• 5–10 years of experience in:
• Product management / engineering / technical solutions
• Industrial products, energy, or engineering companies preferred
• Experience in building or managing SaaS / digital products is highly desirable

Skills & Competencies
• Strong product thinking and problem-solving ability
• Ability to bridge technical + commercial + customer perspectives
• Cross-functional collaboration
• Strong communication skills

Mindset
• Entrepreneurial and ownership-driven
• Comfortable working in a fast-evolving, build-from-scratch environment

This role will be at the core of Pune Gas’ transition from a product + project company to a solutions + innovation-led organization, driving long-term differentiation in the market.

Job Profile: Product Manager I

Location: Bangalore | Karnataka

Years of Experience: 2- 4 years

About the team & role:

AI-led Driver Experience (Onboarding • Payouts • FM Tooling)

We’re hiring a Product Manager I (2–4 years) to help build the next wave of AI-powered driver experiences—with a strong focus on real, measurable impact. If you’re hands-on with AI tools today (or obsessively learning fast), and you want to ship AI-led products that improve how drivers onboard, earn, and get supported—this role is for you.

What you’ll work on (high-impact areas)

>AI-first driver experiences: Build and ship AI-led capabilities across driver journeys—smarter interventions, automation, and new interaction surfaces (including Voice AI as a major thread).

>AI + support experiences: Integrate AI / LLM powered intelligence into support flows to improve resolution speed, quality, and driver trust—while reducing operational load.

>Payouts automation: Scale payout workflows through automation, assisted decisioning, and correctness checks—making payouts simpler, faster, and more reliable.

>Driver onboarding: Reduce activation friction and improve clarity across onboarding states, requirements, and communications for best-in-class onboarding experience.

>Frontline excellence tooling (FM app): Build tools that help field teams operate more effectively—visibility, tasking, verification, and on-ground execution.

>Cross-app surfaces: Some of the work will span the driver app experience end-to-end, not just internal tools.

What you’ll be responsible for

>Own problem spaces end-to-end: discovery requirements execution launch iteration

>Write crisp PRDs + define success: clear problem framing, success metrics, instrumentation, and experiment plans

>Ship with engineering & design: deep collaboration to deliver high-quality solutions, including rollout plans and tricky edge cases

>Partner with ops/support/analytics: ensure what we build works in the real world—not just in specs—and is operationally scalable

>Prototype to move faster: create quick, high-signal prototypes of product ideas (flows, screens, interactions) to accelerate alignment and reduce iteration cycles

- We already use AI-enabled product/design tooling and have access to all the right apps—so you’ll be expected to get hands-on and use them to turn ideas into tangible prototypes early
- This is a key part of the role and a great chance to level up as a next gen PM by working closely with design and engineering from day zero

>Demonstrate ‘Take charge’: identify opportunities for improvement, and drive maintain momentum even in ambiguous situations.

Who is an ideal candidate:

>2–4 years experience in Product (or Engg, or equivalent ownership in a role that demonstrates product thinking)

>Strong execution: ability to take ambiguous problems and deliver results quickly

>Comfort with data and metrics (funnels, cohorts, experiment thinking; SQL is a plus)

>AI-first mindset: hands-on with AI tools/workflows, curiosity to learn fast, and a habit of thinking “how can AI create step-change outcomes here?”

>Strong communication and stakeholder management across business + tech teams

Engineering-background friendly

This role is also open to folks with an engineering background who’ve built products/features and now want to own the “what” and “why”—not just the “how.” If you enjoy shaping requirements, making trade-offs, and partnering closely with engineers to ship end-to-end outcomes, you’ll fit right in.

Why this role is exciting

You’ll work on products that directly impact driver livelihoods and trust—onboarding, earnings, and support—while building AI-led experiences (including Voice AI and automation) that can fundamentally improve scale, clarity, and quality across the driver charter.

title: Product Manager
description_text:
A California-based company is rolling out a new social commerce app -- the first in the US to fuse social, marketplace, cryptocurrency and AI into one cohesive consumer platform.

We're currently experiencing rapid customer adoption and revenue ramp, and (in the coming months) are looking to open an office in Pune, India.

In anticipation of that, we're seeking a Pune-based Product Owner that can start working remotely immediately – on a full-time basis from 4:30pm IST until 1:30am IST.

About the platform:

Co-founded by the only other team (other than Facebook) to previously dominate the U.S. college market social networking space, we're using our prior experience to roll out this new game-changing highly-patented platform on college campuses too. After saturating the college market we'll then open it to everyone else.

Our marketing approach utilizes local feet-on-the-street “Territory Owners” all over the world. They pay us for the opportunity to own their local territory business and share in the revenue opportunities from their territory. Thousands of Territory Owners are now joining us each month, as we have started our marketing efforts to attract them.

Our platform consists of 3 products: The Social app and Marketplace mobile apps (C# back-end, React Native front-end), and our web-based CRM back-office for the Territory Owners (C# back-end and React/MVC front-end).

Key Responsibilities:

A) Defining Product Vision and Strategy: Collaborate with stakeholders to establish a clear product vision, roadmap and product backlog that aligns with business goals, and gather product requirements and translate them into clear specifications and user stories for the development team.

B) Managing the Cross-Functional Team: Working closely with developers, designers, QA and others to ensure clear communication of product requirements and facilitate smooth development processes, to ensure products are launched to customers with speed and quality.

C) Run the daily stand-up – at 4:30pm IST

Compensation would include:

1) Monthly cash compensation

2) Additional cash bonus (monthly profit share)

3) Significant ownership package so that you’re participating in the financial upside generated from your hard work, focus and success. If you are successful with us, this will be the last job you have where you're not the CEO or venture capitalist.

We’re moving very quickly to fill these roles. If you're available now to work full-time remotely (daily from at 4:30pm to 1:30am IST) starting immediately – and feel like it's a good fit -- let us know.

The next step will be to speak with one of our co-founders.

title: Lead Product Manager- Technical
description_text:
As a Lead Product Manager-Technical in the Employee Access Management program within Security Engineering, you will be responsible for developing initiatives derived from business needs, market opportunities, and technology trends. About the role

Alight is seeking an experienced analyst to join the Product Innovation & Enablement team.

As the Technical Demo Analyst, you are responsible for enabling our client-facing and sales teams to demonstrate the value of Alight’s products by supporting the discovery, development and delivery of new product features and enhancements with Alight’s demo experiences.
Job Description

Technical Demo Analyst - Product Management Associate

The demo analyst will serve as a primary subject matter expert/product owner for the live demo (Showcase client). Additionally, the demo analyst may support (as needed) the static demos currently supported by the demo enablement team.

In this role, you will collaborate with product teams and other stakeholders to understand the scope/requirements for the live demo updates as well as support the demo development team to ensure the timely delivery of static demo updates, as needed.

Additionally, you will partner with and support the Demo and Interactive Experience Manager in the creation and maintenance of interactive story/conceptual sales demo experiences (via Figma).

The ideal candidate should have strong presentation, problem-solving, quality assurance skills, and high attention to detail.
Key Responsibilities

The Technical Demo Analyst will report to the Demo and Interactive Experience Manager. The Technical Demo Analyst is responsible for delivering a broad spectrum of tasks, including:

General Demo Support
• Partner with various stakeholders to understand the requirements for any product sales presentations and demo support for both internal and external clients.
• Performs configuration for both the CBA Showcase client and the associated Alight Worklife configuration, based on needs of end users.
• Creates and execute test plans to ensure demo updates and data refresh activities were accurately completed according to documented requirements.
• Establish frequent communication with the relevant stakeholders to monitor demo-related projects and keep everyone informed of the status.
• Be able to work well within a small team and support colleagues on any ad-hoc requirements and tasks.
• Assist in identifying and implementing strategies to create/enhance demo configuration tooling capabilities to support the vast needs of our business partners and sellers

Live Demo Support

Live demo support for the Showcase client is the primary responsibility of the Technical Demo Analysts
• Performs system configuration for CBA and Alight Worklife

Static/Concept Demo Support

The Technical Demo Analyst will also support the broader demo enablement team, when needed.

• Supports the creation of high-quality, interactive story-oriented Figma demos (via Figma) that are engaging to showcase the true value and future concepts of Alight’s products and solutions
• Assist in managing project tasks and use the strong connections you form to collect, improve, and provide demo-related changes/experiences, within scope and on time
• Troubleshoot bugs and errors found during testing to assist the static demo development team in locating and correcting the issue
• Other duties including, but not limited to, assisting other teams if needed.

Team Development

• Is a role model for global and cross-cultural team support

• Coaches broader team on solutions and system tools

Qualifications and Experience
• 2+ years CBA and Alight Worklife configuration experience
• Cross-domain experience in benefits administration, healthcare, retirement, leaves, and HR technology is preferred
• BA/BS degree with a minimum of 2+ years of experience in a business analyst and/or quality assurance role
• 1+ years of experience in creative roles
• 1+ years of experience working collaboratively with engineering/development and design teams
• Proven ability to effectively deliver and communicate with others to achieve desired results; must be approachable and open-minded
• Project management experience taking ideas from concept to launch

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced and dynamically changing environment

title: Engineering Manager, Marketing Platform Automation
description_text:
Role : Engineering Manager, Marketing Platform Automation

Shift : General

At PitchBook, our Product & Engineering team is made up of big thinkers, innovators, and problem-solvers who aim to make a meaningful impact on our customers and company every day. We value curiosity, customer empathy, and the drive to find better ways of doing things. Our work blends creativity with technical expertise to deliver world-class customer experiences through product innovation.

The Marketing Platform team is a cross-functional team consisting of product management, product ownership, and engineers who are responsible for our core Marketing Technology (MarTech) stack. The Engineering Manager oversees the engineers/testers on the team, identifying and overseeing the solutions that meet internal customers’ needs.

As an Engineering Manager overseeing the Marketing Platform in PitchBook’s Enterprise Technology division, you lead the engineering efforts that underpin our marketing technology stack, ensuring seamless integration and optimal performance across our platforms. You play a critical role in driving innovation, efficiency, and scalability within our marketing technology stack. Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, you will ensure that our marketing systems, built around a marketing automation platform (Marketo), are robust, optimized, integrated, and aligned with the company's strategic objectives. This position offers a unique opportunity to blend technical expertise with leadership skills to drive impactful change in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

You build and lead a team of talented engineers responsible for developing and maintaining automation solutions for our marketing suite of tools and systems. You train and mentor engineering team members, identify and resolve impediments, oversee the integrity of software estimations, ensure our code and tests meet high standards, and develop software with scalability, reliability, and maintainability in mind.

This is a full-stack role, where you utilize your strong background in Java, Python, automation solutions (e.g. Workato), web services (REST/OpenAPI), messaging frameworks (e.g. Kafka), data pipelines (e.g. Airflow), cloud technologies (GCP/AWS), caching (e.g. Redis), and persistence (e.g. PostgreSQL) to build innovative solutions. You ensure your team develops a mastery of their discrete business domains and have autonomy, ownership, and accountability for their deliverables. You oversee that the team maintains strong test automation suites, aligning with automated build & CI/CD pipelines and containerized delivery (Kubernetes / Docker / Helm). You dive deep into code as needed.

Your ability to collaborate with product management, provide leadership across multiple locations, set a high bar for our team members, and hire, train, and retain exceptional talent in the organization is foundational to your success. You solicit feedback, engage others with empathy, build leaders on your teams, inspire creative thinking, and help create a culture of belonging, teamwork, and purpose.

Primary Job Responsibilities
• You lead and inspire a team of skilled engineers, providing guidance, mentorship, and support to ensure their growth and success. You foster a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and accountability, ensuring that your team has the autonomy and ownership necessary to excel in their roles
• You oversee the design, development, and maintenance of automation solutions for our marketing technology stack. You ensure that the code produced by your team is of the highest quality, with a focus on scalability, reliability, and maintainability. Your full-stack expertise allows you to dive into the codebase when needed, ensuring alignment with best practices and industry standards
• You are responsible for ensuring that our marketing systems, particularly those built around Marketo, are robust, optimized, and seamlessly integrated. You lead efforts to enhance system performance, drive innovation, and implement scalable solutions that align with the company’s strategic objectives
• You leverage your strong background in Java, Python, cloud technologies, software architecture, messaging frameworks, and data pipelines to drive the technical direction of the marketing platform. You ensure that your team adopts and implements best practices in automation, web services, test automation, and cloud-native delivery
• You work closely with product management, marketing, and other teams to ensure that engineering efforts are aligned with business goals. Your ability to translate complex technical concepts into actionable business strategies is critical to driving impactful change
• You oversee the integrity of software estimations and ensure that the systems your team develops meet high standards of performance, reliability, and security. You are vigilant in identifying and resolving impediments, ensuring that projects are delivered on time and within scope
• You are committed to driving innovation within the marketing technology stack. You continuously seek opportunities to improve processes, tools, and systems, ensuring that the technology supporting our marketing efforts remains at the cutting edge
• You play a key role in hiring, training, and retaining top engineering talent. You set a high bar for performance, create opportunities for professional growth, and cultivate an environment where team members feel valued and motivated to contribute their best work
• You establish and drive a culture founded in creating belonging, psychological safety, candor, connection, cooperation, and fun. You solicit feedback, engage with empathy, and build strong relationships across the organization, fostering an environment where innovative ideas can thrive
• You understand how to apply Agile, Lean, and principles of fast flow to team efficiency and productivity
• Support the vision and values of the company through role modeling and encouraging desired behaviors
• Participate in various company initiatives and projects as requested

Skills and Qualifications
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field
• 8+ years of experience in software engineering with deep experience in software integration, and working experience in workflow automation, marketing technology, or related areas
• 3+ years in an engineering leadership role with direct management responsibilities of at least 3 people
• 3+ years hands-on coding and delivering services that are provided “as a service” to other teams as part of a large-scale distributed microservices architecture
• Strong leadership skills with experience managing and mentoring engineering teams
• Expert-level skills in Java, Python, and SQL
• Deep understanding of marketing automation platforms (e.g., Marketo) and related technologies
• Experience with containerization technologies, including Kubernetes and Docker, and understands how to build for cloud-scale delivery, including scalability, resiliency, and recoverability
• Solid understanding of software development methodologies, Agile practices, and DevOps principles
• Excellent problem-solving skills with a focus on innovation, efficiency, and scalability
• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively engage with stakeholders at all levels of the organization
• Experience in the financial industry or B2B marketing is a plus

Morningstar is an equal opportunity employer

Working Conditions

The job conditions for this position are in a standard office setting. Employees in this position use PC and phone on an on-going basis throughout the day. Limited corporate travel may be required to remote offices or other business meetings and events.

Morningstar's hybrid work environment gives you the opportunity to collaborate in-person each week as we've found that we're at our best when we're purposely together on a regular basis. In most of our locations, our hybrid work model is four days in-office each week. A range of other benefits are also available to enhance flexibility as needs change. No matter where you are, you'll have tools and resources to engage meaningfully with your global colleagues.

description_text:
Whether you’re at the start of your career or looking to discover your next adventure, your story begins here. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your skills and make a difference at one of the world’s most global banks. We’re fully committed to supporting your growth and development from the start with extensive on-the-job training and exposure to senior leaders, as well as more traditional learning. You’ll also have the chance to give back and make a positive impact on where we live and work through volunteerism.

Shape your Career with Citi

We’re currently looking for a high caliber professional to join our team as Senior Vice President, Institutional Credit Management (ICM) Product Developer - Artificial Intelligence (AI) - Hybrid (Internal Job Title: Product Developer - C14) based in Mumbai, India. Being part of our team means that we’ll provide you with the resources to meet your unique needs, empower you to make healthy decisions and manage your financial well-being to help plan for your future. For instance:
• Citi provides programs and services for your physical and mental well-being including access to telehealth options, health advocates, confidential counseling and more. Coverage varies by country.
• Citi provides access to an array of learning and development resources to help broaden and deepen your skills and knowledge as your career progresses.
• We offer our employees resources and tools to volunteer in the communities in which they live and work. In 2019, Citi employee volunteers contributed more than 1 million volunteer hours around the world.

The Product Manager will join our mission to transform how Citi manages Wholesale Credit Risk (WCR), specifically focusing the development of a new platform utilizing Emerging Technologies, among others Generative and traditional AI, to manage how we make origination decisions and perform credit monitoring.

The wholesale lending products under focus include Corporate Lending, Leverage Finance, Real Estate, Securitization, Treasury and Trade Solutions, and more.

As a Product Manager, you will be a part of a new organization named Institutional Credit Management (ICM), which was recently formed to transform the way Citi manages the extension of wholesale credit to institutional clients. ICM is a global group focused on re-imaging credit control process, policies, and technology to manage the wholesale lending process end to end.

Within ICM the Underwriting Product Management function is responsible for managing and developing credit risk strategies and platforms as they pertain to risk appetite management, client engagement, origination decision making, and credit monitoring. Additionally, the product manager is responsible for managing requirements and development activities that will create a user centric experience to meet the needs of differing business lines, regions, and regulatory demands.

With the new Emerging technologies available in current market key responsibility of ICM Product Manager is to develop new use cases and capabilities how to utilize these new technologies within both current and new platforms and processes while increasing data quality, process controls and efficiency.

If you are an individual who takes ownership, strives for client and risk management excellence, and learns from different perspectives to surpass stakeholder expectations, then this is a unique leadership opportunity for you.

This role will work in collaboration with cross-functional and cross-business stakeholders throughout the lifecycle of the initiative. To be successful in this role, the candidate will have previously in-depth understanding of corporate lending and underwriting processes and has familiarity or experience partnering with technology to drive incremental change according to Agile software development principles.

In this role, you’re expected to perform:

Credit Risk Activities in Scope for Transformation:
• Originations & Amendments – Transformation of the deal management lifecycle from prospecting through underwriting, credit administration, and booking operations.
• Periodic Assessment and Client Monitoring – Transformation of the credit review processes including Annual Reviews and Problem credit management
• Portfolio Limit Setting and Management – Transformation of how Citi Manages Limits across Lending and Counter Party Credit products, including implementation of a comprehensive monitoring structure.
• Client Management and Servicing – Transformation of how our clients interact with Citi to execute on their business operation needs, including statements, draws, etc.
• Core Services – Transformation of the underlying foundation, data, and functional services that support the above business activities (e.g. Financial Spreading, Collateral Management, Covenant Monitoring, etc.)

Key Focuses:
• Partner with various ICM colleagues and risk managers to develop origination and credit monitoring strategies for managing credit risk in a timely, accurate and complete manner.
• Utilize modern Emerging technologies for simplification, automation, quality control leading to improvement in Efficiency of internal processes and systems.
• Launch and manage new Products, Projects and Initiatives utilizing Emerging technologies and ensure both technical and governance deliveries of these efforts.
• Effectively navigate from the strategic to the requirement level, enabling the design team to confidently execute designs informed by user needs
• Lead a set of products working groups to maintain outcome-based roadmaps and sequencing, review progress towards OKRs, and track risk dependencies and issues.
• Conduct design workshops that enable collaboration and conceptual solutions, while serving diverse personas
• Leverage journey-based design strategies to drive an overall product design process and validate prototypes into production, including visual design and content strategy.
• Drive digital transformation by re-engineering operational business processes, focusing on optimizing target state processes and end to end workflow orchestration with technology empowerment.
• Follows market, industry, and client trends to own field and adapts them for application Citi’s products and solutions platforms.

As a successful candidate, you’d ideally have the following skills and exposure:
• Bachelor’s degree in business / equivalent or technology related field
• 10+ years of relevant experience
• Expert knowledge in various software development methodologies, and project management concepts (e.g., requirements creation, feature identification, and user story writing)
• Knowledge about Generative AI and Traditional AI. Key features, strong and weak points of these technologies and Experience with their implementation in existing processes.
• Ability to independently lead projects through strategy, design and implementation phases and being accountable for the direct financial impact of the initiatives
• Ability to present various Projects and Product to senior leadership in understandable and capturing way
• Basic knowledge of programming in Python is advantage
• Familiarity in a front office, middle office, or operational capacity supporting the credit lifecycle execution or related transformation efforts in wholesale lending
• Demonstrated ability to translate end user needs into tangible work products that technology engineers can move forward to develop (e.g. Process Flows, Requirements, Design Artifacts, Screen Mockups, etc.)
• Track record of working across multiple stakeholders and collaborating with various technology partners

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a family of more than 230,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

Take the next step in your career, apply for this role at Citi today

title: Product Manager – Enterprise AI Operations & Observability
description_text:
At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. We give our best effort to our work, and we put people first. We’re looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world.

Product Manager – Enterprise AI Operations & Observability

Department: Tech@Lilly

Location: Hyderabad, India

Position Type: Full-Time

Level: P4
Position SummaryEli Lilly is seeking a highly accomplished and strategic technology leader to head our Enterprise AI Operations (AIOps) and Observability functions. This pivotal role is responsible for defining, implementing, and optimizing operational frameworks, platforms, and processes that ensure the reliability, performance, scalability, and security of AI/ML systems and the broader enterprise technology landscape. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in AI/ML lifecycle management, enterprise observability, and automation, with a proven track record of building and leading high-performing teams in complex, large-scale environments. They will also partner closely with the AI Ops Architect to co-develop and execute a cohesive strategy that delivers measurable value across the organization, ensuring alignment between architectural vision and operational excellence.Key ResponsibilitiesStrategic Leadership & Governance

· Develop and execute a comprehensive strategy for enterprise AI operations and observability aligned with business and technology goals.

· Establish governance frameworks, standards, and best practices for AI/ML deployments and enterprise observability.

· Ensure compliance with regulatory, security, and operational requirements.
AIOps & MLOps Maturity

· Drive the adoption of AIOps practices for proactive issue detection, intelligent alerting, root cause analysis, and automated remediation.

· Establish and scale MLOps practices for secure, efficient, and reliable deployment, observability, and lifecycle management of AI/ML models.
Enterprise Observability

· Define and implement a robust observability strategy across infrastructure, applications, networks, security, and data systems.

· Standardize the collection, correlation, and analysis of metrics, logs, and traces across all technology layers.

· Build predictive capabilities and dashboards to anticipate failures and enable proactive interventions.

description_text:
HighLevel is an AI powered, all-in-one white-label sales & marketing platform that empowers agencies, entrepreneurs, and businesses to elevate their digital presence and drive growth. We are proud to support a global and growing community of over 2 million businesses, comprised of agencies, consultants, and businesses of all sizes and industries. Our platform manages over 470 terabytes of data distributed across five databases, operates with a network of over 250 microservices, and supports over 1 million hostnames.

With over 1,500 team members across 15+ countries, we operate in a global, remote-first environment. We are building more than software; we are building a global community rooted in creativity, collaboration, and impact. We take pride in cultivating a culture where innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated, and people come first, no matter where they call home.

As of mid 2025, our platform powers over 1.5 billion messages, helps generate over 200 million leads, and facilitates over 20 million conversations for the more than 2 million businesses we serve each month. Behind those numbers are real people growing their companies, connecting with customers, and making their mark - and we get to help make that happen.

The Mobile Payments Product team at HighLevel is focused on building and scaling a robust, reliable, and seamless payment experience across our mobile ecosystem. We are seeking a Senior Product Manager, Mobile Payments , who will take ownership of the end-to-end mobile payments lifecycle, spanning pre-sales, sales, and post-sales experiences . This role will be responsible for managing a complete suite of mobile payment products, including invoices, estimates, and point-of-sale (POS) , while ensuring a seamless and secure experience for end users.

The ideal candidate will lead initiatives focused on reliability, scale, compliance, and usability , while building a platform-agnostic mobile payments system that supports multiple use cases and customer segments. This role requires strong execution, a deep understanding of mobile payment flows, and the ability to balance customer needs with business and regulatory requirements.

To build a best-in-class, mobile-first payments platform that drives adoption, transaction success, and revenue growth by delivering fast, secure, and intuitive payment experiences across HighLevel's global customer base.

Drive Payment Adoption & Monetization – Increase usage, transaction success, and GMV by improving payment discovery, checkout flows, and post-sale experiences across mobile.

Deliver Core Mobile Payment Capabilities – Lead the end-to-end development of mobile payment features, including invoicing, estimates, POS, refunds, and post-sale workflows at scale.

Champion Mobile UI/UX for Payments – Partner closely with design and engineering to deliver fast, intuitive, and frictionless payment experiences optimized for mobile-first users.

Experiment & Optimize – Design, execute, and analyze experiments to improve checkout conversion, authorization success, and overall payment performance across mobile flows.

Scale, Reliability & Compliance – Ensure the payments platform is secure, scalable, and compliant, with strong ownership of PCI, regulatory, and risk considerations .

Collaborate Cross-Functionally – Work closely with engineering, design, data, sales, support, and finance teams to deliver cohesive pre-sale, sale, and post-sale payment experiences.

Leverage Payments Data for Decisions – Use payments-specific metrics such as TPV, authorization rates, conversion drop-offs, failure reasons, and refunds to inform prioritization and roadmap decisions.

Own Outcomes, Not Just Features – Deliver measurable improvements in payment adoption, transaction success rates, revenue expansion, and overall mobile payments performance.

Payments Platform & B2B2C Experience – You have built and shipped impactful features within a payments or fintech ecosystem, delivering secure, scalable payment experiences that drive adoption, transaction success, and long-term usage at scale.

UX-Driven for Payments – You bring a strong UI/UX sensibility for payment flows, checkout experiences, and post-transaction journeys, with a track record of reducing friction and improving conversion through intuitive design.

Experimentation-Led – You are comfortable designing and running A/B tests and structured experiments to improve authorization rates, checkout completion, and overall payment performance through rapid iteration.

Customer-Centric Mindset – You balance business goals, risk, and user trust, keeping customer needs, confidence, and outcomes at the center of payment-related decisions.

Highly Data-Driven in Ambiguity – You are comfortable working with messy, unstructured, or incomplete data , crunching numbers, identifying patterns, and deriving actionable insights without relying on perfectly organized datasets.

5+ years of Product Management experience , with a strong focus on payments, fintech, or transaction-heavy B2B/B2B2C platforms operating at scale, and 7+ years of total professional experience .

Proven track record of shipping impactful product features that drive measurable improvements in payment adoption, transaction success rates, authorization rates, and revenue growth .

Deep understanding of UI/UX principles for payment and checkout experiences , with the ability to partner closely with design teams to deliver fast, intuitive, and trust-driven user journeys.

Experience driving revenue expansion and monetization through payments, pricing, fees, subscriptions, or transaction-based business models.

Familiarity with SaaS and fintech growth levers , including activation, conversion optimization, retention, lifecycle management, and post-transaction experiences.

Bonus: You have worked on a highly polished payments or fintech product processing significant transaction volume and supporting 1B + Annual TPV , and can clearly articulate your impact on growth, reliability, and customer trust.

Join us at High Level, and you will have the opportunity to learn the intricacies of scaling a B2B SaaS startup and develop impactful products that cater to the needs of our customers.

title: Global Product Manager - Legal
description_text:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

As a Legal Data & Reporting Product Analyst – Manager, you will:
• Act as the day-to-day product delivery lead for the Data & Reporting squad, serving as a proxy for the Product Owner by translating priorities into executable work, unblocking delivery, and coordinating across analysts and engineers.
• Partner with stakeholders across the Legal function to gather, document, and refine reporting requirements, ensuring alignment with senior leadership decision-making needs.
• Design, develop, and enhance business intelligence solutions—primarily using Tableau and/or Power BI—to improve legal operations reporting and analytical insight.
• Define and maintain data models that support analytics use cases, ensuring data quality, integrity, and usability across multiple sources.
• Analyze complex data sets to identify trends, surface insights, and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations for leadership.
• Own and curate a prioritized backlog of reporting and analytics enhancements to drive continuous improvement.
• Support development and execution of the data and reporting roadmap, ensuring alignment with Legal priorities and broader business objectives.
• Partner with data and engineering teams to support data quality, including audits, issue resolution, and process improvements.
• Develop documentation, training materials, and enablement sessions to drive adoption and effective use of reporting tools.
• Monitor reporting usage and performance to identify opportunities for optimization and additional value.
• Lead day-to-day squad execution across analysts and engineers, ensuring delivery against the committed roadmap and acting as the primary point of coordination between the Product Owner and the squad.

What You'll Bring

5–10+ years of experience in data product management, product analytics, data analysis, reporting, or business intelligence within a corporate or professional services environment.
• Experience leading delivery within cross-functional squads or agile teams, serving as a key interface between product leadership and execution teams.
• Demonstrated ability to analyze data, identify trends, and deliver insights that inform senior leadership decision-making and product direction.
• Hands-on experience designing high-quality dashboards in Tableau (Power BI experience a plus).
• Strong experience working with enterprise data platforms, databases, and reporting tools.
• Proficiency in SQL; experience with dbt and Snowflake preferred.
• Familiarity with AI, data science concepts, and Python is a plus.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to support a global team, with flexibility to occasionally work outside traditional hours.
• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related field.

Additional info

YOU’RE GOOD AT

A successful Legal Product Analyst – Manager will thrive in a fast-paced, data-driven environment and excels at:

Problem Solving & Analytical Thinking
• Demonstrating intellectual curiosity and a strong desire to learn.
• Applying structured, strategic thinking to define problems, build hypotheses, and develop data-driven solutions.
• Designing insightful dashboards and reports that deliver meaningful business intelligence.
• Identifying root causes of data and reporting issues and proposing practical solutions.
• Navigating ambiguity in a highly iterative, evolving environment.
• Owning work end to end with minimal oversight.

Communication & Stakeholder Engagement
• Collaborating effectively across global, cross-functional teams.
• Communicating complex data clearly to inform leadership decision-making.
• Building trusted relationships with stakeholders and aligning on priorities.
• Adapting communication style for different audiences and time zones.
• Providing transparent updates and maintaining alignment across diverse stakeholder groups.

Work Management & Execution
• Managing multiple priorities in a dynamic, fast-moving environment.
• Planning, organizing, and driving execution across workstreams, coordinating squad activity and ownership without direct line management.
• Demonstrating strong organizational discipline to ensure accuracy and efficiency.
• Providing clear direction and prioritization to squad members to maintain momentum and delivery quality.
• Proactively driving initiatives through to completion.

title: Product Business Analyst (BA + Product) / Associate Product Manager
description_text:
Apply now : hr@ray.life

Location : Ahmedabad

About Ray

Ray builds secure enterprise networking products and cloud-managed solutions across Wi-Fi, switching, SD-WAN, and network security.

Why You Should Join
• Own outcomes across user discovery → competitive study → roadmap inputs → Jira backlog → documentation → GTM content.
• Work directly with leadership and engineering; high impact and visibility.
• Build repeatable product processes in a fast-scaling product company.

Responsibilities

1) Product Discovery & Requirement Ownership
• Understand user/customer needs via stakeholder interviews, support insights, sales feedback, and usage data.
• Convert inputs into problem statements, user personas, journeys, and use cases.
• Define success metrics for features (adoption, retention, support reduction, revenue enablement).

2) Competitive Intelligence & Market Study
• Track competitors: features, UX flows, messaging, pricing/packaging, and release cadence.
• Maintain comparison matrices and write concise competitive briefs with recommendations:
• parity vs differentiation vs deprioritize.

3) Prioritization & Roadmap Inputs
• Propose feature prioritization using impact/effort, customer value, revenue impact, risk, and dependencies.
• Align priorities with leadership, engineering, and GTM timelines.

4) Execution via Jira (Scrum)
• Convert requirements into epics → user stories → tasks/subtasks with strong acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then).
• Drive backlog hygiene (labels/components, dependencies, versions, story readiness).
• Participate in Scrum ceremonies and ensure sprint readiness (DoR/DoD discipline).

5) Cross-functional Coordination & Work Allocation
• Break down work into clear modules and route/assign to the right owners (FE/BE/Firmware/QA/DevOps/Docs).
• Track progress, unblock teams, manage dependencies, and ensure scope clarity through delivery.

6) Product & Technical Documentation
• Write and maintain: feature specs, configuration guides, admin/user docs, release notes, FAQs, and internal enablement notes.
• Validate documentation with engineering and QA for accuracy and completeness.

7) Content & Marketing Collaboration (Publish Pipeline)
• Work with content team on briefs, outlines, and product accuracy.
• Review content for correctness, clarity, positioning, and consistency.
• Coordinate with marketing to publish product content (website pages, blogs, datasheets, launch notes) aligned to releases.

Tools & Methodology (Must Have)
• Jira: Epics/stories, workflows, boards, reports, dashboards.
• Scrum/Agile: planning, grooming, sprint cycles, DoR/DoD, retrospectives.
• Documentation platforms: Confluence/Notion/Google Docs.

Skills & Experience Mandatory
